build_jsonl_dataset: build a JsonlDataset from a JSONL file path with optional tokenizer and epoch configuration
run_precompute_index: run the CLI to precompute index files for JSONL files matching a glob pattern
create_mmap_reader: create a memory-mapped file reader for efficient random access to JSONL data lines
test_jsonl_dataset_getitem: test the JsonlDataset __getitem__ method to retrieve and parse a specific JSONL document by index
review_jsonl_dataset_exists: review the JsonlDataset exists static method to check if a JSONL file path exists on disk
